scenes.title: The question you just asked holds the top
scenes.note: A submitted prompt takes the viewport top and the reply fills the space beneath it. Read back into history and the way home is the same frame: the wheel and PgDn land on it again.

scenes.title: The prompt that owns what you are reading
scenes.note: Scroll back over a turn boundary and the prompt that asked for those rows pins itself at the top; the rail on the right marks the turn you are in, and the foot of the screen says how far back you are — click it to come home. Shift+←/→ jumps between turns.
